content:
tina-release: FYI scheduling a coordinated deploy at 02:00 UTC: api@v1.9.9, runtime@2.10.4, router@3.3.9. Console needs to add X-Canary and X-Session headers for canary routing.
jo-runtime: Runtime change exposes a new light-kernel path and optional batching. Default batching OFF for canary. Prefetch behind `prefetch_toggle`.
max-router: Router 3.3.9 adds session affinity when X-Session present; safe fallback otherwise. Console must set both headers in proxy for canary tokens.
anya-console: Ill open a hotfix PR to add headers to canary proxy. Preview will be up shortly: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/4399
theo-eng: Recommend pinning all three for initial waves. Rollback rule: if 5xx > 0.45% for 5m OR regen p95 > +18% for 5m -> rollback runtime only. Also auto-hold if mem pressure > 84%.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by tina-release for 02:00 UTC. Waves: 10% -> 30% -> 100%. Pin queued. Canary watchers: jo-runtime, max-router, anya-console.
tina-release: Please pin before first wave: `/deploy pin api@v1.9.9 runtime@2.10.4 router@3.3.9 --note "canary pin 02:00"`
deploy-bot: Command queued: `/deploy pin api@v1.9.9 runtime@2.10.4 router@3.3.9`. Confirm with :thumbsup:.
jo-runtime: :thumbsup:
max-router: :thumbsup:
anya-console: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Wave 1 (10%) started at 02:00:21 UTC. Monitoring hooks: latency, 5xx, session-misses, mem pressure.
jo-runtime: Wave1 looks stable. Prefetch cold-misses as expected. Batching OFF.
max-router: Headers present, session matches fine. No churn.
anya-console: Preview shows headers set only for canary tokens.
deploy-bot: Wave 2 (30%) started at 02:08:45 UTC.
jo-runtime: At 30% regen p95 +9% baseline, mem 60%, 5xx 0.11%.
theo-eng: Hold 6m then proceed if stable.
deploy-bot: Wave 3 (100%) initiated at 02:17:30 UTC.
jo-runtime: p95 peaked +13% then settled to +10% after 2m. 5xx remains low.
max-router: Session-miss rate ~0.5% during canary, within tolerance.
anya-console: Release note draft in PR description.
tina-release: Proceed to unpin api/router, keep runtime pinned for +20m. `/deploy unpin api router`
deploy-bot: Commands executed. Runtime pinned until 02:37:30 UTC. Canary closed. :white_check_mark:
